ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity white/off-white pixels in the lobe centers versus 35% low-intensity black pixels at the perimeter and axial regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions in the center of both lobes. The right lobe exhibits higher density low-intensity mottling and flecking compared to the left. A single, high-contrast dark focal spot is located in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate 40-45 degree angle with a moderate depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude peaks most pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trajectory from the median notch extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast, elevated textured pixels (barnacle colonies) are present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) oriented vertically/diagonally across the mid-section of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent bio-fouling/barnacle colonization at both fluke tips; distinct rake mark scars on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique isolated dark circular pigment spot in the upper quadrant of the left lobe's white region.
